paraphrase: Daily conduct: sleep at the right time, oil massage and moderate exercise, cleanliness, and a moral life — avoiding the ten non-virtues, speaking gently, thinking before acting, helping others and honouring the worthy — for conduct is part of health.

paraphrase: The physician must have six qualities: intelligence; a pure, altruistic intention — love, compassion, joy and equanimity towards patients; commitment to the physician's vows; skill in body, speech and mind; diligence in the work; and knowledge of worldly conduct. Such a physician is like the Medicine Buddha to beings.

paraphrase: The channels (rtsa) are of four kinds: channels of formation, of existence, of connection and of life; along them run the winds, blood and the body's constituents, and the vital points must be known for treatment.

paraphrase: The distant cause of all disease is ignorance — the failure to understand selflessness. As a bird soaring in the sky is never parted from its shadow, so beings, even when happy, are never parted from it. From ignorance arise desire, hatred and delusion, and from them rlung, mkhris pa and bad kan respectively.
